description: This Java source file defines the `PickListServices` class which provides utility methods related to pick list processing within the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically handling order header retrieval and bin completion checks.

classes.name: PickListServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services related to pick list processing, including converting order IDs to headers and checking bin completion status.

methods.name: convertOrderIdListToHeaders
methods.description: Converts a list of order IDs to their corresponding order header objects, querying the database for approved sales orders, and returns the list as part of a map.

methods.name: isBinComplete
methods.description: Checks whether all items in a specified picklist bin are completed or canceled, returning true if so.
